summary: With --agent, any mutating command (pp:method POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE or pp:mutation) runs as --dry-run unless --yes is passed.
reason: Agents must show a plan before changing the tailnet; the hook wraps root PersistentPreRunE so generated endpoint mutations inherit it without edits to generated files.
validated_outcome: TestAgentModeForcesDryRunOnGeneratedMutations: `device delete --agent` sends no DELETE; with --yes it sends one.
